items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: We called him Ham, but his name was Jessie Hamilton. We went out with him.

ctx.x: Pete Jones, myself, my brother, and another cat played... We called him Ham, but his name was Jessie Hamilton. We went out with him. You know, that was a... Travelin' like that in a big Pullman car, with a cook, everything -- a kitchen and everything on there.
Excuse me. What did Jessie Hamilton play?
